name: @local/dsh-danbooru-tools
description: DSH bundle (not a standalone program) — AI-made, read-only, image-only Danbooru tools. Default (core) preset registers the 12 most-used tools: post/tag search, tag details, related tags, year-favorites artist ranking, tag-based style matching, similar artists, image-to-artist search, pixel-similarity style matching (with per-artist closest-year annotation), surface-finish profiling (matte thick painting vs glossy cel), credentials. toolPreset="full" (or DANBOORU_TOOL_PRESET=full) adds the four rarely used extras: weighted Hot/rising artist ranking, part specialists, multi-scheme consensus and single-post lookup. NAI prompt strings emit weight-1 tags bare (no :: wrapper) and put a space before the comma after a digit-ending tag ("hews 2024 , ..."). Surface profile tool scores matte thick painting vs glossy cel shading on eight axes. Image-to-artist keeps a leader board per dimension, so a one-aspect specialist still reaches the artist string (or the try_next queue) instead of being cut by the whole-image ranking. Every pixel/surface score also reports a matte composite: the edge descriptor alone cannot tell matte thick painting from glossy cel shading (both score ~95), so surface_gate="matte_thick" is the switch that keeps hard-specular artists out of a matte reference.
